answer: Locks are written down in raven, expire in mirror, and bridge lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 111 aliases therefore needs 133 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 113 dollars in locked collateral and another 9 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
